items.stem: What does Copilot in Teams need in order to produce a meeting summary with speaker attribution?

options.text: A meeting transcript with attributed speakers
options.rationale: Correct: Copilot relies on a transcript with speaker attribution.
A title alone cannot produce a content summary.
Attribution and summary depend on the transcript, not just a recording.
Per-summary admin approval is not the mechanism.

items.stem: Which TWO outputs can Copilot intelligent recap provide after a meeting? (Select TWO.)

options.text: AI-generated action items from the discussion
options.rationale: Correct: recap surfaces AI-generated tasks/action items.

options.text: Name mentions showing where a person was referenced
options.rationale: Correct: recap includes mentions with timestamps.

options.text: A guaranteed error-free transcript requiring no review
options.rationale: Transcripts and summaries can contain errors and need review.

options.text: Access to meetings the user was not entitled to see
options.rationale: Copilot respects access; it does not expose unauthorised meetings.

items.stem: Before assigning a task from an AI-generated action item, a good practice is to:

options.text: Verify the attributed decision against the transcript or participants
options.rationale: Correct: AI attributions should be checked before acting.

options.text: Assume the AI owner assignment is always correct
options.rationale: AI can misattribute; verification is needed.

options.text: Delete the recap to avoid duplication
options.rationale: Deleting the recap loses useful context.
Transcription is what enables recap in the first place.
